answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The ledge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the trellis. Reaching the atlas of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
